decisions.reason: As a recently launched extension of the firm’s core authentication and secure communication offer in a growing market, its value is still uncertain and the option should remain open.

This mobile PDF digital signature function is close to the firm’s established capabilities and strategic direction, so with only a short time on the market there is not yet enough evidence to justify abandonment.
A multi-layer end-to-end security architecture fits the firm’s deep cryptography and platform strengths, and preserving this option is sensible while market learning is still incomplete.
The secure email-to-app delivery robot builds on the existing secure messaging stack and likely has low incremental continuation cost relative to its potential cross-channel value.
Although it involves hardware, the QR-code-based signature token is close to the firm’s signing and authentication business and should be retained until its commercial potential becomes clearer.

The payment network security compliance suite leverages the firm’s security and regulatory positioning, and in the absence of negative results it is worth keeping as an option in a growing digital security market.
